text:
Asking rents in Karlsruhe stand at a median of 13.53 €/m² (2026-06), up 4.8% on the year and +26.3% over five years. That ranks Karlsruhe #13 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 60% above the 2022 average contract rent of 8.46 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 812 € a month in cold rent, 17.1% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 22 days and 30% are gone within a week; with 1.5% market-active vacancy and -1.0% population growth over five years, the market looks broadly balanced.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 13.99 €/m² (+3.4%), with an 80% range of 13.55 to 14.40 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
